name: Science Fiction Prototyping
description:
Science fiction prototyping uses fictional narratives to explore how a technology or design proposition might operate within a future social context. Rather than describing a technology in isolation, the story considers people using, adapting to or resisting it.

The narrative becomes a prototype of relationships and consequences rather than a prediction of what will happen.
whenToUse: Use science fiction prototyping when emerging technologies need to be considered beyond technical capability and when social adoption, everyday use or longer-term consequences are important.
steps: Identify the technology or change to investigate.
Introduce a character or community affected by the development.
Describe an everyday situation in which the technology matters.
Introduce a conflict, limitation or unexpected consequence.
Explore how people and institutions respond.
Reflect on what the story reveals about the original proposition.
Use those insights to revise assumptions or generate alternative futures.
lookOutFor: Avoid technological determinism: technologies do not independently produce social outcomes.
A compelling story is not evidence that a future is probable.
Consider perspectives beyond the intended adopter or heroic innovator.

resources.citation: Johnson, B. D. (2011). *Science Fiction Prototyping: Designing the Future with Science Fiction*. Morgan & Claypool.
